AppVerifier privacy policy

This app does not connect to the internet on its own and requires no network permissions. The "View source code" button in settings opens the project's GitHub page in your default browser.

This app does not collect, transmit, or share any personal data. All processing is performed locally on your device.

Installed apps. This app can see which apps are installed on your device in order to display information about them and verify their signatures. This information is used only while the app is running and is not stored or transmitted.

Verification and clipboard. Verification info for an individual app can be shared or copied to other apps using the share and copy buttons. You can also verify an app by pasting verification info from your clipboard or by sharing verification info received from others to this app. Clipboard content and text shared to this app are not stored — they are used only to check whether the given package name and hash match the selected app, and are then discarded.

APK files. If you provide an APK file to this app, it is temporarily stored in this app's cache directory and deleted once the needed signature information has been processed.

User database. You can save app verification entries to a user-created database. These entries consist of package names and signature hashes. They are stored persistently on your device and remain until you delete them or clear the app's data. You can view, export, or delete entries at any time through the settings screen. Export writes a file to a location you choose via the system file picker; import reads a file you select through the same mechanism. No third party has access to this data.

Clipboard checkmark. When clipboard verification succeeds, the verified package name is stored locally so a checkmark can be displayed in the app list. This list persists until you clear it through the settings screen or clear the app's data.

Data retention. User database entries and clipboard-verified package names are kept until you delete them or clear the app's data. APK file copies are deleted immediately after processing. All other data is ephemeral and exists only in memory during use.

Your rights. Because all data is stored locally and under your control, you can exercise any data rights — including access, rectification, and erasure — directly through the app's user interface. You do not need to contact anyone to modify or delete your data.

Contact. If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can open an issue at:
https://github.com/RoundSalmon4/AppVerifier

Changes to this policy. This privacy policy may be updated from time to time. When it does, you will be prompted to accept the new policy upon opening the app.

Last updated: May 27, 2026.
